name: Lords of Waterdeep
metaTitle: Lords of Waterdeep Score Calculator (with Skullport)
metaDescription: Free Lords of Waterdeep score calculator for 2–5 players. Add the VP track, Lord bonus, leftover adventurers and gold, plus Skullport corruption.
intro: The hidden Lord card in Lords of Waterdeep can change everything at the end. Reveal the Lords, enter each player's numbers and the calculator gives the final standings.

categories.label: Victory point track
categories.help: Points scored during the game from quests, buildings and intrigue cards.

categories.label: Lord of Waterdeep bonus
categories.help: The bonus from your secret Lord card, for example 4 points for each completed quest of two particular types.

categories.label: Adventurers left
categories.help: Clerics, fighters, rogues and wizards still in your tavern.

categories.label: Gold
categories.help: Gold left over. Every 2 gold scores 1 point.

expansions.name: Scoundrels of Skullport
expansions.description: Adds corruption. Each corruption token in your tavern costs points equal to the current value on the corruption track.

categories.label: Corruption penalty
categories.help: Your corruption tokens multiplied by the current value shown on the corruption track. It is subtracted.

tiebreaker: If players are tied, the one with the most gold wins. If still tied, they share the victory.

rules.heading: How scoring works in Lords of Waterdeep
body: The game lasts eight rounds. Most points are scored during play: completing quests, owning buildings that others use and certain intrigue cards all move you along the victory point track.
At the end, players reveal their Lord of Waterdeep card and add end-game points to their track score.

rules.heading: End-of-game points
body: Each adventurer cube still in your tavern is worth 1 point, whatever its type. Every 2 gold is worth 1 point. Your Lord card then gives a bonus, usually 4 points for each completed quest of the two types it names. One Lord instead rewards buildings you control.

rules.heading: Scoundrels of Skullport
body: The Skullport expansion adds corruption, which offers powerful actions at a cost. At the end, each corruption token in your tavern loses you points equal to the value currently shown on the corruption track. Multiply and enter the total; it is subtracted.

faq.q: How much are leftover adventurers worth?
faq.a: 1 point per adventurer cube in your tavern.

faq.q: How much is gold worth at the end?

faq.a: The tied player with the most gold wins.
